scope: Study-specific interpretation of an airborne VOC-human health finding; not a chemical hazard classification or body-of-evidence conclusion
execution: AI-executed, browser-assisted pilot; no human scientific review and no independent model validation
lock_note: Rules recorded after development-paper review, before completing the remaining eight assessments. Discovery abstracts for candidate papers were already visible. This is not a blinded, preregistered or independent holdout evaluation.

input_fields.critical_alternative_explanation: boolean; AI judgment with source-linked rationale, not a certified risk-of-bias rating
input_fields.controls_adequate_for_narrow_claim: boolean; cannot establish absence of residual confounding
input_fields.robustness_support: boolean; within-paper support, not independent replication
input_fields.precision_sufficient_for_claim: boolean; does not mean a nonsignificant result establishes no effect

rules_ordered.condition: Critical alternative explanation is true OR controls adequate is false
Controlled or quasi-experimental contrast AND robustness support AND precision sufficient
Otherwise, after passing the preceding gates

null_result_rule: Display the finding direction and uncertainty separately. A rating describes the interpretability of this finding, not support for a harmful effect. No equivalence or safety claim from nonsignificance.
context_rule: Background cited by an article is unverified context and cannot upgrade the indicator. No external field-level rating.
exposure_rule: Biomarker association alone does not establish an ambient or indoor air route. Do not conflate a VOC species with a correlated mixture.
design_rule: No automatic rating solely from the design label. Timing and controls are assessed for the exact question.
index_question_rule: Use stated primary objective when identifiable; otherwise select an explicitly described illustrative VOC-result contrast, record the selection, and do not call it prespecified by the original authors.
disclaimer: AI-generated research assessment; not yet validated against human expert review.
